# Selected Simple Icons

SVG path data vendored from https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/16.35.0/icons
at release 16.35.0. Only GitHub, X, Bluesky, Mastodon, YouTube, Instagram,
Twitch and Reddit are included. No runtime CDN or package install is required.

Upstream collection license: CC0-1.0 (LICENSE.md). Brand names and marks belong
to their respective owners; see the upstream DISCLAIMER.md included here.
To update, replace the selected paths from a pinned upstream release and
review its license/disclaimer and brand guidelines. Never load SVG supplied
by profile authors into the document. The generic globe is Wiredove's own path.
